title: Patch for CRD migration loop triggering node-agent flapping during on-prem control-plane upgrades
creator: Maya Chen
description: Production customer clusters (private/VPC and on-prem) experienced operator-driven node-agent 'flapping' after an operator Helm upgrade that ran a CRD migration hook. The migration toggled a legacy CRD status field which caused the operator reconciler to repeatedly requeue objects and patch node-agent DaemonSet annotations; this created rapid restarts of the node-agent leading to elevated pod churn and application request errors. Multiple customers opened escalations during the upgrade window.
comments: 2026-03-05 09:12 - Customer A SE reported increased 5xx rates and node-agent restarts immediately after an on-prem operator upgrade window. Initial slack thread: #inc-private-upgrades.

2026-03-05 10:01 - Triage: reproduced in staging by running helm upgrade with the migration hook enabled. Observed migration job writing a 'migratedAt' timestamp into CRD.status and then removing an old finalizer. Operator reconciler watches CRD.status and issues a patch to the node-agent DaemonSet on each change.

2026-03-05 13:40 - Root cause hypothesis: migration hook writes status multiple times (retries on API conflict) and reconciler lacks idempotent guard. Combined with kubelet liveness sensitivity on node-agents (config drift: liveness probe timeout set to 5s in several customer clusters), this caused rapid restart loops.

2026-03-06 08:22 - Mitigation applied to affected clusters: temporarily scaled node-agent DaemonSet to 0 (manual mitigation), blocked further helm upgrades by informing CSMs, and applied kubelet probe tuning guidance to customers as a short-term stopgap.

2026-03-06 11:15 - Engineering patch plan: (1) add migration coordination flag to CRD (migrationLock) so migration writes are idempotent, (2) add operator-side debounced reconciler: ignore status patches if timestamp delta < 30s, (3) make node-agent DaemonSet patch operations conditional (only apply if hash differs), and (4) add retries with exponential backoff to migration hook to avoid writing duplicate status entries.
2026-03-07 16:05 - PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference-operator/pull/289 - implements migrationLock and reconciler debounce. Unit tests and integration test harness updated.
2026-03-08 09:30 - QA: ran upgrade job and validated no repeated DaemonSet patches in a 1-hour smoke test; simulated API conflicts to ensure migration hook backoff behaves correctly.

2026-03-09 14:00 - Hotfix release cut: operator-2.4.1-hotfix with the backported changes to 2.4.x branch. Release PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference-operator/pull/294. CHANGES: migration idempotency, reconciler debounce, conditional patching, improved logging.

2026-03-10 02:20 - Deployed hotfix to affected customers using private upgrade path and on-prem operator Helm chart (helm upgrade --reuse-values). Post-deploy: customer telemetry shows node-agent restart rate returned to baseline within 10 minutes.

2026-03-10 08:45 - Customer communications: sent incident summary and recommended post-upgrade validation checklist (Confluence doc): https://confluence.redwood.example/display/OPS/CRD+Migration+Hotfix+Checklist.

2026-03-11 12:10 - Postmortem notes: migration hook lacked API-rate-awareness; reconciler assumed single-change events. Action items created for longer-term fixes: implement e2e cluster upgrade test suites (ENG-16280), add drift detector for kubelet probe configs (ENG-16281), and add a graceful-rollback helm pattern to avoid mid-upgrade resource churn (PM-412).

2026-03-12 17:00 - Follow-up: backported the fix to operator-2.3.x for customers on older minor releases (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference-operator/pull/301). Scheduled scheduled automation to validate migration hooks in CI can run against a mocked API conflict scenario.
2026-03-14 09:55 - Closeout: verified with 3 escalated customers; monitoring dashboards stable. Documented hotfix in release notes and internal ops runbook. Marking ticket Done.

Notes and links: Grafana incident dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/upgrade-ops/node-agent-restarts?orgId=1&from=now-6h, Incident runbook: /runbooks/CRD-migration-upgrade-failure.md, Customer escalation thread: https://slack-redwood/archives/C01234ABCD/p1678002000000000
